_comment: Example course schedule: copy to course_schedule.json and edit. Lecture N is the Nth meeting day on or after first_day, skipping no_class dates. no_recording lists meeting days that count as lectures but have no recording (e.g. in-class exams). slots assign a recording to a section by its start time (used by voicememos.py): numbered slots follow the lecture schedule (NNN-lecture-MM); others are named by date. instructors: 'default' for the course; 'lectures' keyed by lecture id (010-lecture-12) or by number for all sections.
